I had a great experience at this clinic. I came here for a full blood test and hormone check, and everything was very professional and well organized.

The staff were very friendly and helpful from the moment I arrived. They explained everything clearly, helped me choose the right test package, and answered all my questions. The nurse who took my blood was very skilled and gentle, so the process was quick and almost painless.

The clinic itself is very clean, modern, and well managed. I didn’t have to wait long at all, and the whole visit was smooth and efficient.

Overall, I’m very impressed with the service and professionalism. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants reliable health checkups and a comfortable experience.

Thank you to the whole team!

I had a great experience at Pulse Clinic Phuket. The staff were professional, friendly, and made me feel comfortable throughout the visit. The clinic was clean, well-organized, and the service was efficient. I really appreciated the clear explanations and the respectful, non-judgmental atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone seeking reliable healthcare in Phuket.

This place’s PCR testing is low key a scam.

As far as I can tell, they do perform the tests they say. However, the panel includes a number of bacteria which are guaranteed to be found. Gardnerella vaginalis, for example, is a normal part of vaginal flora and will definitely be present if you have a vagina or have been in contact with one recently.

The scam is they detect it, tell you you need treatment, and you come in and they sell you antibiotics which you take for no reason. This is both predatory and poor antibiotic stewardship.

Feel free to use their testing services, but know their game.

Aside, they offered a discount for my previous 5-star review: “great service, very friendly. around 5200 bhat for a reasonably complete panel”. They specifically required it to be five stars, which is why they have so many five star reviews. That’s also pretty scammy behavior, IMO.
I have been to this clinic 2 times for medical check up and medication. The staff are knowledgeable, professional and friendly. I recommend this clinic.
Very excellent service especially from Tuan, he is very empathetic. I’m happy that we could start immediately with the treatment and so far everything seems to be alright now.
